simple.meaning: בְּהֵמָה (bᵉhêmâh) appears 190 times in the Hebrew Scriptures as a person-name in the Hebrew text.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, beginning at Genesis 1:24. The background comes from the surrounding verses where the name appears.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to בְּהֵמָה (H929) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows בְּהֵמָה through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.
simple.summary: בְּהֵמָה (bᵉhêmâh) / H929 is tracked through Genesis 1:24, Genesis 1:25, Genesis 1:26, Genesis 2:20. The entry is generated from source alignment, occurrence evidence, and the surrounding Scripture context.

definitions.short: properly, a dumb beast; especially any large quadruped or animal (often collective)
definitions.full: H929. behemah בְּהֵמָה 187 noun feminine beast, animal, cattle (Arabic ) — ׳בּ Gen 1:24 137t.; construct בֶּהֱמַת Num 3:41 (twice in verse) + 10 t.; suffix בְּהֶמְתְּךָ Lev 19:19 4 t.; בְּהֶמְתֶּ֑ךָ Exod 20:10 4 t.; בְּהֶמְתּוֺ Gen 36:6 ; Prov 12:10 ; plural absolute בְּהֵמוֺת Deut 32:24 6 t. + Psa 73:22 (see below); construct בַּהֲמוֺת 8:8 5 t.; — beast , & collective beasts ( Gen 8:1 + very often) 1 of living creatures other than man ( אָדָם ) Gen 8:1 ; Exod 8:13 ; 8:14 ; 9:9-10 , 22 ; 22:18 ; Lev 18:23 (twice in verse) (where ׳בּ is male, so 20:16 ) Deut 27:21 ; Psa 36:7 etc.; בּ וְעַד ׳מֵאָדָם ( ׳בּ including all the larger animals) Exod 9:25 ; 12:12 ; Psa 135:8 ; Jer 50:3 etc.; as inferior to man Job 18:3 ; Psa 49:13 ; Psalm 49:21, so also Eccl 3:18-19 , (twice in verse); 3:21 ; opposed to also birds & reptiles Gen 6:7 ; 7:23 ; 8:17 compare Ezek 44:31 etc.; also to fishes 1Kin 5:13 ; Job 12:7 compare 12:8 , Psa 8:9 ; Zeph 1:3 . 2 opposed to also to wild beasts ׳ח הַשָּׂדֶה הָאָרֶץ, חַיַּת Gen 1:24-25 , 26 ; 2:20 ; 3:14 ; 7:14 , 21 ; 9:10 ; Psa 50:10 ; 148:10 ; Isa 46:1 etc.; especially therefore cattle , as owned and used by man, Gen 47:18 ( הַבּ ׳מִקְנֵה ) Exod 20:10 = Deut 5:14 ; Lev 19:19 ; 26:22 ; Num 3:41 (twice in verse); 3:45 (twice in verse); Deut 2:35 ; 11:15 ; Jonah 4:11 ; Zech 2:8 ; 8:10 ; 14:15 ; Ezra 1:4 , 6 ; Neh 9:37 ; 10:37 etc.; in one (late) passage of animal for riding (horse ? mule ?) 2:12 (twice in verse); 2:14 . 3 rarely of wild beasts , especially carnivora, ׳בּ יַעַר Micah 5:7 ; ׳בּ הָאָרֶץ Deut 28:26 ; Isa 18:6 (twice in verse); Jer 7:33 ; 15:3 ; 16:4 ; 19:7 ; 34:20 ; ׳בּ הַשָּׂדֶה 1Sam 17:44 ; alone, Prov 30:30 ; שֶׁןבְּֿהֵמוֺת Deut 32:24 ; בּ ׳שֹׁד Hab 2:17 . — On בְּהֵמוֺת Psa 73:22 compare below
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root (probably meaning to be mute );
